framing: He Was Socrates is a measurement story: every claim (TTFT, defer-rate, cache reuse, on-device egress) is a number with an inspectable source. The preview makes the engine performance legible at a glance — KPIs, time-series, dispatch share, funnel — so a Kaggle judge can audit the abstention mechanic and PR-Lambda speedup as data, not rhetoric.
target_persona: Kaggle/DeepMind judges who are skeptical of LLM marketing and need bench-grade evidence — they want n, p10/p50/p90, hardware, commit SHA. Secondary: Two-Weeks-Team engineers who use this dashboard during release reviews.
primary_surface: Local-only analytics dashboard (no external analytics SDK, all data from claudedocs/bench/2026-05-06-latency-bench.json): 4 KPI cards on top, TTFT time-series line chart with p10/p50/p90 reference lines center, function-dispatch pie chart right, end-to-end turn funnel bottom with conversion + per-step latency, methodology footnote with hardware/n/commit.
opus_4_7_capability: Quantitative reasoning over a structured bench JSON: extract per-turn first-chunk-latencies, compute percentiles, classify dispatch via deferred flag, render the result as inline SVG charts inside a self-contained HTML — without any external chart library or telemetry SDK (preserves the NO-CLOUD invariant even at the preview layer).
mvp_scope: One static analytics page rendered from real bench JSON (n=10 turns + reuseProbe shots). Day-1 demo: scrolling judge sees four KPI cards, a TTFT line chart with reference percentiles, dispatch share pie, and a funnel from Spacebar press to idle — every number cites bench file + commit 3f02a34.
one_liner_pitch: Every claim becomes a chart: TTFT 192ms p50, 96% cache reuse advantage, 20% defer rate — measured on M1 Max, n=10, sourced to one bench JSON.
spec_alignment_notes: target_persona=judges (English-reading, technical-leaning) per spec — chose dashboard surface because spec differentiator #5 (PR-Λ 24× TTFT) and #1 (abstention mechanic) are both quantitative claims that benefit from chart-form audit. primary_surface diverges from spec section_order (which is narrative scroll) into analytics-dashboard form per P13 mockup-style mandate; treated as complementary artifact (the data-room companion to the narrative preview). Defer rate computed from bench (2/10=20%) rather than the 13% prompt hint, because spec constraint 'every metric cited has a markdown hyperlink to commit/bench JSON; zero unsourced numbers' overrides the prompt hint — annotated in dashboard footnote. Korean confined to bust subtitle + defer drilldown (평어체 verbatim) per spec language_policy.
